async def act(page):
    # Fill the textbox in the open 'Invite members' dialog with the usernames
    usernames = "ASWATFZLLC, patrickhlauke, westurner, linkmatrix"
    await page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Invite members").get_by_role("textbox", name="Please add members to invite", exact=True).fill(usernames)

    # Click the 'Invite' button to submit the form
    await page.get_by_role("dialog", name="Invite members").get_by_role("button", name="Invite", exact=True).click()

    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    return
